question: Welche Vorteile und Grenzen haben Retrieval-Systeme?

search.question: Welche Vorteile und Grenzen haben Retrieval-Systeme?

hits.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Knowledge Work
hits.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation can ground generated answers in a changing knowledge base and expose supporting passages for enterprise knowledge work.
limitations: Answer quality depends on retrieval coverage and source freshness.
The system still needs evaluation for unsupported claims.

hits.title: Context Selection and Ranking in Long-Document Retrieval
hits.abstract: Adding more retrieved context does not always improve an answer; irrelevant or poorly ordered passages can distract a model, so selection and ranking remain important.
limitations: Long-document behavior can vary with context order.
Retrieval scores alone do not prove answer correctness.
